data.raw: The logo for 'Der Südstern' is set against a black background. On the left, there is a white graphic of an eagle with its wings spread wide. Below the eagle's head is a white profile of a human head facing left. To the right of this graphic, the word 'Südstern' is written in a large, bold, white, sans-serif typeface. The letters are thick and have a slightly irregular, hand-drawn appearance.
